channel.title: BBC Proms
channel.desc: Classical music's biggest party reaches its spectacular climax. Superstar pianist Yuja Wang plays Summertime and Feeling Good, and world-class tenor Nicky Spence celebrates his homeland with a rousing medley of Scottish songs, and an unmissable rendition of Sit Down You're Rocking the Boat from the hit musical Guys and Dolls. Plus, rousing performances of Holst's Jupiter and all the Last Night traditions, from Land of Hope and Glory to Auld Lang Syne. Presented by Katie Derham and Nick Mohammed.
